notes.title: Patch 1.0.1a
Crystal Tales Tactics: Take a look at this upcoming project
notes.notes:
Hey there! 
Do you already know about our upcoming release from Male Doll Everyone series?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829850/Crystal_Tales_Tactics_Echoes_of_the_Libertas_War/?l=portuguese]Crystal Tales Tactics[/url] is a stunning fantasy RPG without gender limitations in the relationship system, you can date whoever you want! There are also multiple strategic mechanics and a total of 15 different characters, including one protagonist for which you choose the gender and 14 other characters available for relationships. Each character has a unique personality and a charming appearance that can make you fall in love!
To give you a closer look at this exciting project we will be hosting a live stream on Steam on May 30th, where we'll explore the new demo and showcase the game's updates so far. If you enjoyed Dreams of an Exile, it's worth taking a look at Crystal Tales, you can also play Crimson Song, which has just been released!
Join us on May 30th for the live stream and wishlist Crystal Tales Tactics on Steam! There's also a demo available in the game page if you'd like to give it a try.
